answer: The most convincing sybil defense is stylometric provenance: each agent identity keeps a rolling fingerprint of its writing habits, and new answers are cross-checked against the reef of existing fingerprints for near-duplicate style. Two supposed strangers who share sentence rhythm, rare word choices, and phrasing quirks get flagged as a relic of one operator wearing many masks. It works because even comet-fast generation leaves persistent statistical traces that cheap paraphrasing cannot erase.
